components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single ink-black Watch now action; the only emphasis on the screen, with a loading spinner state.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 58px; padding: 0 26px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #0A0A0A); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--ink, #0A0A0A); color: var(--paper, #FAFAFA); font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ink-hover, #2B2B2B); border-color: var(--ink-hover, #2B2B2B); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #0A0A0A); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: var(--gray, #6B6B6B); border-color: var(--gray, #6B6B6B); cursor: wait; } .ds-btn-spinner { width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 2px solid rgba(250, 250, 250, 0.45); border-top-color: var(--paper, #FAFAFA); border-radius: 50%; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary.is-loading .ds-btn-spinner { opacity: 1; animation: ds-spin 0.7s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

components.name: Small Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #E4E4E4); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--ink, #0A0A0A); font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #0A0A0A); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #0A0A0A); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The single ID field; white well, hairline border, ink focus ring, tabular figures.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="IMDb or TMDB ID or link" aria-label="IMDb or TMDB ID or link">
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 58px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #E4E4E4); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--ink, #0A0A0A); caret-color: var(--ink, #0A0A0A); font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--gray, #6B6B6B); } .ds-input::selection { background: var(--ink, #0A0A0A); color: var(--paper, #FAFAFA); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--ink, #0A0A0A); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.08); } .ds-input.error { border-color: var(--ink, #0A0A0A); border-width: 2px; }

components.name: Ruled Row

components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; gap: 20px; padding: 13px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #E4E4E4); font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; } .ds-row-key { width: 110px; flex: none; padding-top: 2px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gray, #6B6B6B); } .ds-row-value { flex: 1; min-width: 0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; word-break: break-all; } .ds-row-value a { color: var(--ink, #0A0A0A); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-row-value a:hover { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-row-value a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #0A0A0A); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Safety Notice
components.description: The quiet fine print at the foot stating the app hosts nothing and links to third parties.
components.html: We don't host anything. We only link to third-party providers. Check the URL before playing. Prefer an ad blocker for safety.
components.css: .ds-notice { width: 100%; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #E4E4E4); padding-top: 16px; text-align: center; } .ds-notice p { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--gray, #6B6B6B); }

narrative.overview:
A stream lookup is a plain product screen, not a themed object. The answer is one typographic record on a white field; the ticket metaphor and its costume are refused. Monochrome Product Canon treats the pasted ID as the shortest path to a link, with no ornament between the visitor and the answer.

The field is paper-white and the ink is near-black. One centered column, hairline rules, and strict monochrome do all the structuring; a single soft-offset shadow under the found record is the only depth. One workhorse grotesk, self-hosted Archivo, speaks at every role — there is no second display face and no monospace costume for identifiers. The found link resolves into one quiet, ruled record: the movie title as the lead line, a small year-and-rating line beneath it, then IMDb ID, provider, and full stream URL, with a single ink-black primary action and nothing else asking for attention.

The visitor pastes an ID, presses Watch now, and reads that record before leaving for the provider. Black is the only emphasis; the link is the product. A quiet line at the foot states that the app hosts nothing. Recognizable with all content removed by its centered column, thin rules, and strict monochrome. Provenance: Monochrome Product Canon, seed 7a0f6ff53762f44b, from the surface direction contract (safer re-roll, grounded card 1 of 2).

rules.name: The Strict Monochrome Rule
rules.body: Strict monochrome: near-black ink, paper field, white surfaces, gray secondary, hairline rules. Ink is the only emphasis; the link is the product.

rules.name: The One-Voice Rule
rules.body: One workhorse grotesk — self-hosted Archivo — at every role, with no second display face and no monospace costume. One real type scale.

rules.name: The Balanced Lead Rule
rules.body: The movie title is the lead: it wraps with balance and carries a quiet year-and-rating line beneath, with no separate label above it.

rules.name: The One-Screen Rule
rules.body: One page, one input, one action. The answer is one quiet, ruled record on a white field, and the exact destination shows before the user leaves.

rules.name: The Soft-Offset Rule
rules.body: The record carries one soft-offset shadow; the field, surfaces, and dialog stay flat. Hairline rules do the structuring.

rules.name: The Content-Removed Rule
rules.body: Recognizable with all content removed by its centered column, thin rules, and strict monochrome.

dos: Do show the exact provider, canonical IMDb ID, and full stream URL before the user leaves the site.
Do keep the third-party warning and safety note quiet and readable beneath the result.
Do keep the centered column, hairline rules, and strict monochrome recognizable with all content removed.
Do keep one workhorse grotesk and one real type scale at every role.
Do keep the labelled input, keyboard-accessible dialog, focus return, and reduced-motion support.
Do keep the single ink-black primary action as the only emphasis; the link is the product.
donts: Don't add a second display face or a monospace costume for IDs and URLs; Archivo carries every role.
Don't add color accents, gradients, or themed carets and selection; the field stays paper-white and the ink near-black.
Don't theme this as a ticket, coupon, or discovery page with navigation, hero, or cards; the ticket metaphor is refused.
Don't round beyond the small control radius or stack extra shadows; the record carries one soft-offset shadow on a white field.
Don't hide or reword the third-party warning; the product states it hosts nothing.
Don't put a "Stream Found" label above the movie title; the title is the lead.
